deadline.value: Fall applications are due before December 15.
deadline.quote: All applications for Fall admission should be received before December 15 for both the biochemistry program and the chemistry program.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are no longer required.
gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores is no longer a requirement of the application to the doctoral programs in chemistry or biochemistry.

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry GRE Subject score is not required but may help.
gre_subject.quote: A Chemistry or Biochemistry GRE Subject Exam Score is not required but may aid your application.

supervisor.value: The division you pick at application is administrative only and does not limit your choice of supervisor after admission.
supervisor.quote: does not affect your ability to select research areas or supervisors once admitted to the program.

funding.value: The department offers a stipend, full tuition scholarship and health care subsidy.
funding.quote: We offer a generous stipend in addition to a full tuition scholarship and health care subsidy.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked.

notes: Biochemistry is a separate PhD admitted by the same department with the same December 15 deadline.
